problems.title: Compare exponents with the same base
problems.question: Solve $(1/3)^{3/x}\ge3^{2+x}$.
problems.idea: Rewrite the left side as a base-3 power.
steps: The numerator is (x+1)²+2>0 for all real x.
The fraction is therefore nonpositive exactly when x<0.

problems.title: Volume of a regular hexagonal pyramid
problems.question: A regular hexagonal pyramid has short base diagonal 6√3. The distance from the apex to that diagonal is 5. Find its volume.
problems.idea: The distance to the diagonal combines the pyramid height and its centre-to-diagonal distance.
formulas: Base edge a=6; distance from base centre to a short diagonal=a/2=3.

problems.title: A logarithmic inequality describes a disk
problems.question: Find the area defined by $\log_2\sqrt{y^2-2y+6}\le\log_4(6x-x^2)$.
problems.idea: Convert the base-4 logarithm to base 2.
steps: Thus (x−3)²+(y−1)²≤4. All log domains are automatically valid on this disk.

problems.title: A radical exponent with a decreasing base
problems.question: Solve $(3-\sqrt6)^{\sqrt{2x(x+1)}}\ge((3+\sqrt6)/3)^{-(x+1)}$.
problems.idea: The second base is the reciprocal of the first.
steps: The radical domain is x≤−1 or x≥0; the right side must be nonnegative. Thus x=−1 or x≥0.
Squaring gives (x+1)(x−1)≤0. Combine with the domain.

problems.title: Largest cube inscribed in a sphere
problems.question: A ball has volume 36π. Find the volume of the largest inscribed cube.
problems.idea: Its body diagonal equals the sphere diameter.

problems.title: An exponential parameter question with no matching simple choice
problems.question: Find every a for which 2^{|x|}=ax²+a² has at least one real solution.
problems.idea: Set t=|x|≥0 and solve the equation as a quadratic in the parameter a.
steps: The negative branch is at most −1: if −1<a<0, then a²+at²<1≤2ᵗ, so no solution is possible. Every a≤−1 does give a root by continuity, starting with t=0 when a=−1.
The positive branch A(t)=[√(t⁴+4·2ᵗ)−t²]/2 is continuous, positive and tends to infinity. Its range is [m,+∞), where m is its global minimum.
Numerically the minimum is m≈0.8017260079, attained near t=2.5739081. An exact description is m=min over t≥0 of A(t).
Thus the full parameter set is (−∞,−1] together with [m,+∞). In particular a=0 does not work, so the printed choice a≤1 cannot be correct.
problems.note: The scan prints an exponent |x|. If 2|x| was intended instead, that different equation would give a≤1. The listed choices suggest this may be the misprint.

problems.title: Integer solutions of logarithms of even powers
problems.question: How many integer x satisfy lg(x¹⁶)−lg(x⁸)−8≤0?
problems.idea: Even powers allow negative x, but x=0 is forbidden.

problems.title: Volume from three apex-edge vectors
problems.question: In pyramid MABC, MA=MB=MC=6. Their pairwise angles are 90°,90°,30°. Find the volume.
problems.idea: The edge perpendicular to both others is perpendicular to their plane.
steps: The triangular base AMC has area 9.

problems.title: Two monotone terms give one boundary root
problems.question: Solve 3ˣ<10−log₂x.
problems.idea: The left side plus log₂x is strictly increasing for x>0.
steps: Because the increasing function equals 10 at x=2, it is less than 10 precisely for 0<x<2.

problems.title: An inscribed sphere in a 3–4–5 cone
problems.question: A cone has radius 3 cm and height 4 cm. Find the volume of its inscribed sphere.
problems.idea: The axial section’s inradius is the sphere radius.

problems.title: Count lattice points in a logarithmic region
problems.question: How many integer-coordinate points satisfy log₂x+log₂y≤log₂(6−x)+log₂(10−y)?
problems.idea: Enforce the log domains before simplifying.
steps: For integer x=1,2,3,4,5, the allowed positive y counts are respectively 8,6,5,3,1.

problems.title: The sign of a squared logarithm
problems.question: Solve [log_{√2}(x−3)]²/(x²−4x−5)>0.
problems.idea: The squared numerator is nonnegative; track its zero and the original domain.
formulas: x>3; denominator=(x−5)(x+1); numerator zero at x−3=1.
steps: For 3<x<5 the denominator is negative, so the quotient cannot be positive.
For x>5 it is positive and the numerator is nonzero. x=5 is forbidden.

problems.title: A square pyramid with a vertical edge
problems.question: A pyramid has square base and a lateral edge perpendicular to the base of length 5. The other lateral faces make angle α with the base, tanα=5/4. Find its volume.
problems.idea: Take a section perpendicular to the opposite base side.

problems.title: Integer inputs of a variable-base logarithm
problems.question: How many integer solutions satisfy log_{4−x²}(x+4)≤1?
problems.idea: The base must be positive and unequal to 1.
steps: At −1 and 0, the logarithm is 1. At 1 it is log₃5>1.

problems.title: Rotate an obtuse isosceles triangle around a leg
problems.question: An isosceles triangle has equal sides √3 and included angle 120°. It rotates about one equal side. Find the generated volume.
problems.idea: Use the centroid-distance volume rule, or subtract the two axial cones.
formulas: Triangle area=3sin120°/2=3√3/4; altitude to the rotation side=√3sin120°=3/2.
steps: The centroid is one third of this altitude from the rotation axis, so its distance is 1/2.

problems.title: Volume of a regular triangular frustum
problems.question: A regular triangular-pyramid frustum has base edges 1 and 3 and lateral edge 2. Find its volume.
problems.idea: Find the vertical height from the difference of circumradii.
steps: h=2√6/3. The base areas are √3/4 and 9√3/4, with geometric mean 3√3/4.

problems.title: A regular triangular pyramid from an apothem
problems.question: A regular triangular pyramid has apothem 2√5 and lateral-edge inclination 45°. Find volume.
problems.idea: Use base inradius r and circumradius R=2r.
steps: 5r²=20, so r=2,h=4. The equilateral base edge is 2√3r=4√3.

problems.title: A cone from a sector-shaped net
problems.question: A cone’s net is a 144° sector of radius 5. Find its volume.
problems.idea: The sector radius is the slant height; its arc equals the base circumference.

problems.title: A nested logarithm inequality
problems.question: How many integer x satisfy log₂(log₃(log₄x))<0?
problems.idea: For a base-2 logarithm to be negative, its positive argument must be below 1.
steps: There are integers 5,…,63, a total of 59.

problems.title: A percentage increase in a sphere’s radius
problems.question: By what percentage does a sphere’s volume increase when its radius increases by 50%?
problems.idea: Volume scales as the cube of radius.
steps: The increase is 3.375−1=2.375 times the original, or 237.5%.

problems.title: A square root of a logarithm
problems.question: Solve $\sqrt{\log_3(9x+18)}\le\log_3(x+2)$.
problems.idea: Set t=log₃(x+2).
steps: Squaring gives t+2≤t², or (t−2)(t+1)≥0. Together with t≥0, this means t≥2.

problems.title: The perimeter of a logarithmic diamond
problems.question: Find the perimeter of the figure log₂(|x|+1)≤log₂(4−|y|).
problems.idea: An increasing logarithm lets us compare its positive arguments.
steps: This is a diamond with vertices (±3,0),(0,±3). Its boundary satisfies the original domains.

problems.title: A rational logarithmic sign chart
problems.question: Solve (2−log₀.₅x)/(8−5x)>0.
problems.idea: Use domain x>0 and locate numerator and denominator zeros.
formulas: 2−log₀.₅x=2+log₂x; zero at x=1/4; denominator zero at x=8/5.
steps: The numerator is negative below 1/4 and positive above. The denominator is positive below 8/5 and negative above.
Their signs agree only between 1/4 and 8/5.

problems.title: Vertical separation between two graphs
problems.question: Find x where the vertical distance between g(x)=1.25 and f(x)=log₉(9x+27) is less than 0.25.
problems.idea: A distance below 0.25 gives an open interval for the logarithm.

problems.title: Cancel logarithms only on their common domain
problems.question: Solve $\lg\sqrt{1+x}+3\lg\sqrt{1-x}\le\lg\sqrt{1-x^2}$.
problems.idea: Every log argument must be strictly positive.
steps: Subtract the right side and use 1−x²=(1+x)(1−x). The left-minus-right simplifies to lg(1−x).
Thus lg(1−x)≤0, equivalent to 1−x≤1, or x≥0.
